critique: The torn-newsprint spiral, revolving multicolour word rings, and broken arc bands turn dense Dada debris into a bold, hypnotic concentric vortex while the plum-black ground satisfies the low-key tone. The typography is too evenly distributed and radially obedient to feel truly anti-aesthetic; larger collisions, abrupt scale shifts, or the absurd guinea pig promoted from its nearly invisible 16-pixel corner would inject the missing Neo-Dada disruption.
